entries.en: Learn the corridors. Ordinary zombies follow the maze paths. Reach the exit alive.
entries.zh: 熟悉通道。普通僵尸会沿迷宫追击，活着抵达出口即可通关。

entries.en: A larger maze and more dead ends. The map remembers where you have walked.
entries.zh: 迷宫扩大，死路增多。小地图会记录已经走过的区域。

entries.en: More zombies and faster reinforcements. Keep moving and check your ammunition.
entries.zh: 僵尸增多，增援更快。保持移动，留意弹药和装弹时机。

entries.en: Gunfire reaches farther than the blade. Switch weapons to control how many zombies investigate.
entries.zh: 枪声传播距离远于长刀，切换武器控制被吸引调查的僵尸数量。

entries.en: Visible fog pockets reduce both player awareness and zombie sight. Use the explored map to cross them.
entries.zh: 可见的局部雾区会同时限制玩家观察和僵尸视野，结合探索地图穿过雾区。

entries.en: Emergency lighting and elite zombies increase pressure without changing during the short run.
entries.zh: 应急红灯和精英僵尸提高压力，短局内环境状态保持稳定。

entries.en: Most fixed lights are offline. Use the flashlight, quieter attacks and remembered corridors.
entries.zh: 大部分固定照明关闭，利用手电、安静攻击和已记住的通道前进。

entries.en: Miasma drains health outside safe lights. Lamps also stand in side routes and dead ends.
entries.zh: 离开避难灯范围会受到瘴气伤害，支路和死路同样可能存在灯柱。

entries.en: Fog pockets, elites and contamination combine while the environment remains consistently readable.
entries.zh: 局部雾区、精英敌人和污染机制组合出现，同时保持环境规则稳定可读。

entries.en: Red warning lights, frequent enemies and group alerts make noisy routes dangerous.
entries.zh: 红色警戒灯、频繁敌人和群体警报使高噪声路线更加危险。

entries.en: Fog now limits distant visibility. Use nearby landmarks and your explored map.
entries.zh: 浓雾遮挡远处视野，结合附近地标和探索地图判断方向。

entries.en: Large purple zombies join the hunt. They have more health, move faster and hit harder.
entries.zh: 紫色大型僵尸加入追击，生命更高、移动更快、攻击更强。

entries.en: Light changes during the run. Your flashlight remains available through the night.
entries.zh: 关卡中昼夜交替，夜间仍可借助手电观察前方。

entries.en: Miasma drains health outside safe lights. Lamps also stand in side routes and dead ends; they do not mark the exit.
entries.zh: 离开避难灯范围会受到瘴气伤害。支路和死路也会有灯，灯光不代表出口方向。

entries.en: Fog, elites, night and miasma combine. Longer routes and tighter safe zones raise the pressure.
entries.zh: 浓雾、精英、夜晚和瘴气同时出现，路线更长，避难范围缩小。

entries.en: More frequent enemies and more elites. Retrace explored paths when a route becomes unsafe.
entries.zh: 敌人增援更频繁，精英更多。道路危险时，可沿探索记录重新规划路线。

entries.en: The largest maze and strongest combined pressure. Clear this exit to finish the campaign.
entries.zh: 最大的迷宫与多重生存压力，抵达出口即完成十关战役。

entries.en: Clear the previous level to unlock the next. Replaying a cleared level keeps your progress.
entries.zh: 通关上一关后解锁下一关，重玩已通过的关卡不会清除进度。

entries.en: All equipped weapons gain 8% range, up to 1.5x.
entries.zh: 全部武器的射程加成增加 8%，普通升级最高 1.5 倍。

entries.en: All equipped weapons deal 12% more damage, up to 2.0x.
entries.zh: 全部武器的伤害加成增加 12%，普通升级最高 2 倍。

entries.en: All equipped weapons fire 10% faster, up to 2.0x.
entries.zh: 全部武器的攻速加成增加 10%，普通升级最高 2 倍。

entries.en: Add one pistol. Limited only by the 6 total slots.
entries.zh: 增加一把手枪，只受六个总武器槽限制。

entries.en: Add one SMG. Limited only by the 6 total slots.
entries.zh: 增加一把冲锋枪，只受六个总武器槽限制。

entries.en: Add one laser. Limited only by the 6 total slots.
entries.zh: 增加一把激光枪，只受六个总武器槽限制。

entries.en: Restore 20 HP. Hidden while health is full.
entries.zh: 恢复 20 点生命，满生命时不出现。

entries.en: Increase maximum and current health by 15.
entries.zh: 最大生命和当前生命同时增加 15 点。

entries.en: Increase movement speed by 0.5, up to 9.
entries.zh: 移动速度增加 0.5，普通升级最高为 9。

entries.en: Increase experience attraction range by 0.5, up to 6.
entries.zh: 经验物吸收半径增加 0.5，最高为 6。
当前全部武器伤害乘以 1.4，独立于普通升级上限。
当前全部武器攻击频率乘以 1.3。
受到的全部伤害降低 35%，仍需躲避首领攻击。
最大生命增加 60，当前生命同步增加 60。

entries.en: Recover 3 health per second while alive.
entries.zh: 存活时每秒恢复 3 点生命，不会复活。
当前全部武器射程乘以 1.3。
已集齐六武器 / 击败守卫者
